examples: 'SvasatAM ca SfRomyenaM goputrARAM pratodyatAm ( =pratodyamAnAnAm)' (BA॰anu॰117.11). pratodena totreRa vyaTyamAnAnAmityarTaH.
'plavaH pratudAm' (Apa॰Da॰1.17.33). tuRqena pratudya ye Bakzayanti te dArvAGAwAdayaH pratudaH. praSabda AdikarmaRi. pratudati todanamAraBate.
'nistudyate yasya Siro'timAtram' (suSruta0 uttara0 25.9). nistudyate balavat pIqyate. atimAtramityukte nirnirarTako Bavati.
'virAwaM vitudantyete gfDragomAyuvAyasAH' (BA0 strI0 20.23). vitudanti viluYcanti, avalumpanti.
'vi pUzannArayA tuda paRericCa hfdi priyam' (f0 6.53.6). vituda=viDya.
'SunaM suPAlA vi tudantu BUmim' (aTarva0 3.17.5). vitudantu=viliKantu, vikfzantu.
'naKAgrEH kena te BIru vitunnaM hi stanAntaram' (rA0 5.68.7). vitunnam=vikzatam.

'AtodinO nitodinAvaTo santodinAvuta' (aTarva0 7.95.3). AtodinO sarvato vyaTakO, AhantArO, tAqayitArO. tataM vIRAdikaM vAdyamAnadDaM murajAdikam. vaMSAdikaM tu suziraM kAMsyatAlAdikaM Ganam.. caturviDamidaM vAditrAtodyanAmakam (amara:).
'AtodinO nitodinAvaTo santodinAvuta' (aTarva0 7.100.3). nitodinO nitarAM nikfzwaM vA vyaTayantO atikazwaM bADAkAriRO.
'vidvezamuttudati cetasi nAsikA me' (avadA0 nA0 13). uttudati utpAdayati.
'Aruhya vfkzAnnirmUlAn gajaH paritudanniva' (BA0 u0 75.8). pAdErmardayanniva. parirujanniti pAWAntaram.
